title: A home for Hacktoberfest apps
summary:
Hacktoberfest app hosting got its groundwork, app-origin API requests gained verification, and the workflows got a little tidier.

A new workflow and app registry were added to support hosting Hacktoberfest projects on pollinations.ai subdomains. The Sirius Cybernetics elevator challenge received a more specific subdomain configuration; its app code did not change.

The text and image API cache workers gained Turnstile verification for requests from local development and non-API pollinations.ai subdomains, with support for browser preflight requests.

A 180-second edit debounce moved to the description-condensing workflow, where it can let rapid edits settle. The app deployment workflow was also adjusted to skip its registry file.
